inlines.v: PHYTOL'OGY, noun [Gr. a plant, and discourse.] A discourse or treatise of plants, or the doctrine of plants; description of the kinds and properties of plants. Pia mater, [Latin] in anatomy, a thin membrane immediately investing the brain.
